title: Prep 5 STAR-format behavioural answers
persona: Mehak, final-year, day-1 placements next week
scenario: You have day-1 placements next week. Top 5 behavioural questions you'll get: ‘tell me about yourself’, ‘a time you led without authority’, ‘a time you failed’, ‘a conflict you resolved’, ‘why this company’. You want STAR-format answers (Situation, Task, Action, Result), each under 90 seconds spoken, that don't sound rehearsed, with one ‘what I learned’ moment at the end of failure/conflict ones. No ‘perfectionism is my biggest weakness’.
badPrompt: give me 5 behavioural interview answers in STAR format
badOutput:
1. Tell me about yourself: I am a passionate final-year student with strong academic record and leadership experience.
2. Lead without authority: In my college club, I motivated the team to deliver a successful event.
3. Failure: I once missed a deadline but learned to manage time better.
4. Conflict: I resolved a disagreement through open communication.
5. Why this company: I am inspired by your culture and growth opportunities.

hints.title: Force the 90-second test
hints.body: ‘Each answer ≤ 90 seconds spoken. Cut anything that sounds rehearsed.’ Long answers tank your behavioural round.

hints.title: Ban the ‘perfectionism’ cliché
hints.body: ‘No “perfectionism is my biggest weakness” energy. Real failures, real lessons.’ Interviewers grade on credibility.

checks.tip: Name the 5 specific questions, not generic.
Lock the spoken length, 90 seconds per answer.
Ban the perfectionism cliché and rehearsed-sounding answers.
Demand a ‘what I learned’ on failure/conflict answers.
Specify the structure, S+T+A+R+learning per answer.
Force a spoken-natural voice, not written-formal.

tipIfLow: Behavioural prep from AI sounds AI because it's too polished. The unlock is the 90-second cap, banning the perfectionism cliché, AND demanding real specific situations + a ‘what I learned’ tag on failure/conflict ones. Interviewers grade on credibility, not vocabulary.
goldPrompt: Act as an interview coach. I'm Mehak, day-1 placements next week. Output STAR-format answers (Situation, Task, Action, Result + Learning where relevant) for the 5 questions: 'tell me about yourself', 'a time you led without authority', 'a time you failed', 'a conflict you resolved', 'why this company'. Constraints: each answer ≤ 90 seconds spoken (~180 words). Banned: 'perfectionism is my biggest weakness', 'I'm a people person'. Failure and conflict answers must end with one specific lesson. Before drafting, ask me for ONE real situation per question — refuse to invent stories I didn't live.
